items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: Well, they said he'd been with various bands like Bull Moose Jackson and Ray Charles

ctx.x: Uh, he seemed a very good musician. Uh, being a dyed in the wool, uh, Bunk Johnson and Lewis fan, uh, to be quite frank, no saxophone, uh, really moves me. Although, uh, having heard Manuel Paul, uh, play tenor, I found that quite interesting. Uh, but this, uh, lad was obviously a good musician. There's no two ways about that. Again, he played with a fairly strong vibrato. Uh, I would have liked to have heard him on some other instrument. I think you suggested to him, he might perhaps like to play a soprano or a…

easier to listen to on one of those instruments. Well, they said he'd been with various bands like Bull Moose Jackson and Ray Charles, and I hadn't expected anything which was generally in the New Orleans idiom that much out of somebody who'd been with those people. No, No, he seemed, he seemed to be familiar with what they were doing. He was conversing with,
there's nothing sure of. Yeah, and, and, uh, it's strange how those people pop out of, out of nowhere. He would have been relatively young too, I'd say, wouldn't he, about 25 or so?
